title: Container Bookings: which customer roll fee entry a goodwill request is decided against
content:
## Rule
A goodwill waiver of a Container Bookings customer roll fee is decided only against a fee entry already on the booking's account. Before the waiver is decided, this must hold:

> The customer roll fee row the customer wants waived is already charged on the booking's account.

Where the customer asks for goodwill on a customer roll fee that the booking owes but that has not been charged, the waiver is decided only once that fee stands as a charged entry, and the waiver then references that charged entry.

The fee entry concerned is the latest customer roll fee entry of the booking by booking date. When the booking carries no customer roll fee entry, there is nothing to waive.

## Input, judgement, output
| Customer roll fee entries on the booking | Entry concerned |
|---|---|
| none | nothing to waive |
| one, dated 3 April | the 3 April entry |
| two, dated 3 April and 9 May | the 9 May entry, the latest by booking date |

*Dates are hypothetical inputs, for illustration only.*

## Points of judgement
**The customer points to an older roll fee on the booking.** The entry concerned is still the latest customer roll fee entry by booking date.

**The customer describes a roll fee that appears nowhere on the account.** A goodwill decision needs a charged entry; an uncharged amount is not waived as such.
